posts.name: CCUsage Gauge
posts.tagline: Track Claude Code & Codex limits, credits and costs
posts.description: Know how much Claude Code and Codex allowance you have left. See 5-hour and weekly usage, reset countdowns, Claude extra usage and Codex credits, alongside token counts and API-equivalent cost history. Free and open source, with a macOS menu-bar app, native or browser dashboard, and a CLI for macOS and Linux. Explore usage by model, agent, machine and directory; connect remote machines over SSH. Install with Homebrew.

posts.name: Code Buster
posts.tagline: Static analysis for AI-assisted codebases
posts.description: Code Buster is a free, open-source CLI for repository-aware code review. Find dependency cycles, duplicated code, complexity hotspots, architecture violations, and correctness, security and performance risks. Run it locally, in CI or alongside coding agents. No source uploads or AI-provider calls. Findings include evidence and remediation guidance, with actionable issues separated from advisory review signals.

posts.name: Brand Voice Claude Plugin
posts.tagline: Check brand voice & compliance inside Claude
posts.description: Brand Voice Checker brings The Lost Agency's brand voice and claims-compliance checks into Claude. Paste a product description, an email or a social post and ask Claude to check it.

posts.name: ALLQR
posts.tagline: Free QR Code Generator & Smart Links
posts.description: Generate free Dynamic QR Codes, Static QR Codes, Smart Links, URL Shortener, Bio Links, Digital Business Cards and QR Analytics.

posts.name: Battery Pack for M5 ADV
posts.tagline: Battery Pack for M5 ADV
posts.description: A compact snap-on battery pack for M5Stack Cardputer ADV, adding 2500mAh capacity and approximately 6 hours of extra runtime.

posts.name: iPand
posts.tagline: See if AI recommends your brand, and what to fix
posts.description: When a customer asks ChatGPT "what's the best…", the AI names a handful of brands. iPand shows if yours is one of them. Every day, it asks ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, AI Mode and Copilot the questions your customers ask. See your AI visibility score, who gets recommended instead, the sources AI cites, what AI says about you and the traffic AI sends you (Google Analytics 4 and Search Console). Then fix what matters with prioritized GEO tasks. Data hosted in Europe.

posts.name: Goodz
posts.tagline: It helps b2b buyers find suppliers and suppliers find deals.
posts.description: Procurement software

posts.name: Display Local
posts.tagline: Local news and events on screens around town
posts.description: Display Local brings local events, announcements, and business messages to screens in the places people already visit. Community content stays updated automatically, hosts can add their own content, and local sponsors can support the network. For businesses, chambers, cities, and community organizations.

posts.name: Curate
posts.tagline: Unlock Your Style potential
posts.description: A living, intelligent Fashion World that grows with you. Identity, intelligence, imagination, visualization, reality, memory.

posts.name: Flying
posts.tagline: Know everything about your flight
posts.description: Flying is the flight tracker with blazing-fast delay alerts, turbulence forecasts for your route, airport wait times, detailed seat maps, and a logbook of every flight you take.

posts.name: atoll
posts.tagline: A Dynamic Island for Claude Code
posts.description: Stop flipping back to the terminal to check if Claude is done. Atoll shows what Claude is doing, what it's changing and what it's costing, right where your eyes already are, and tells you the moment it's your turn. No plugins, no extension, no account: one setting points Claude Code at a relay on your own machine.

posts.name: iphone-backup-sync
posts.tagline: Fast, incremental iPhone DCIM backup for Windows via USB
posts.description: Fast, non-destructive Windows desktop app to sync & verify iPhone photos/videos over MTP (WPD API) built with Tauri v2, Rust & Vue 3.

posts.name: Zgadka
posts.tagline: Audit & fix how ChatGPT, Perplexity & Gemini see your site
posts.description: Traditional SEO isn't enough anymore—users now ask ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini directly. Zgadka audits your website for Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and technical SEO, then generates ready-to-deploy JSON-LD and llms.txt files to boost AI citations.

posts.name: Catchline
posts.tagline: Bar path and joint angles on your lift video, on-device
posts.description: Add a video of your lift and get it back with the bar path, body lines and joint angles drawn on the real footage. Works for snatch, clean and jerk, squat, deadlift, pull-ups and muscle-ups. Step frame by frame, draw your own lines, and export a video with the overlays burned in. Tracking runs on your iPhone: your video never leaves it and is never used for training. Free for 3 videos a week, Pro unlocks unlimited.

posts.name: PhysicsSimulation
posts.tagline: Interactive STEM simulations for Classes 6–12, JEE & NEET
posts.description: PhysicsSimulation turns hard-to-visualize concepts into hands-on experiments across Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics and Biology. Built for Classes 6–12, JEE and NEET learners, it combines interactive simulations with teaching notes, quizzes and key formulas—so students can explore processes step by step, test ideas and learn by doing. Teachers can also request custom simulations.

posts.name: Umbrella
posts.tagline: Record audio from any app on macOS
posts.description: Seamlessly isolate and capture per-app audio—Spotify, Zoom, Safari, Discord, or Logic and other apps straight into MP3 or high-efficiency AAC files with zero latency.

posts.name: ReDefiNER by Jungroo AI Labs
posts.tagline: Entity extraction using long, complex rules, on a CPU
posts.description: ReDefiNER is an open-weight 0.8B model for entity extraction controlled by a plain-English prompt. List the entity types, describe each and add rules about what counts, up to about 10,000 tokens; it returns exact spans with a type and a confidence. The prompt is encoded once and cached, and editing it changes what it finds with no retraining. Built on Qwen3.5-0.8B, it is one 0.77 GB int8 file that runs offline on a CPU. Apache 2.0.

posts.name: Argus by CautionLabs
posts.tagline: Content moderation that runs on your own servers
posts.description: Argus 1 is a text moderation model you run on your own servers with one Docker command. It checks 12 categories (toxicity, hate, harassment, self-harm, PII, spam and more) and returns a clear true/false for each, with no thresholds to tune. Your users' text never leaves your network, and it works air-gapped. One-time $299: unlimited installs and requests. Prefer hosted? The same model is a cloud API at $0.40 per 1,000 requests. Built for English text.

posts.name: FlowState
posts.tagline: Interview and Speech Practice
posts.description: FlowState is a web app that helps students be fully prepare for their next interview. On FlowState, you can practice various interview styles. Each questions comes with unexpected follow up questions that way are ready for all types of interview questions that may show up during real interviews. After every interview you can see an analysis on your interview performance including your filler words, pacing, story-telling, etc. FlowState offers Speech Drills as well.

posts.name: Deckster Invoice
posts.tagline: GST-ready invoices for creators
posts.description: GST-ready invoices for creators.

posts.name: AsanaLab
posts.tagline: A calm, step-by-step yoga course for complete beginners
posts.description: AsanaLab teaches complete beginners yoga one pose at a time: clear photos, plain-English steps, breathing cues, common mistakes and a guided practice timer. Start with 5 poses free, no account needed. When you're ready, unlock the full 30-day programme (30 poses, 4 stages, at your own pace) for a one-time ₹299.

posts.name: Spare Minute
posts.tagline: One short exercise while your coding agent works
posts.description: Your agent is working, and you reach for your phone. Spare Minute turns that wait into one short exercise. When Claude Code, Codex or Cursor starts a long task, your screen softly blurs and an exercise appears: chin tucks, a doorway stretch, desk push-ups. Do it, press Done, and you're back as your agent finishes. Quick questions never trigger it. It clears the moment your agent needs you. Not now? Hold esc and it waits for your next prompt. Free for Mac and Windows, no account.

posts.name: Work In Slippers
posts.tagline: Remote jobs where worldwide really means worldwide
posts.description: Most remote job boards trust the company's "worldwide" tag. Then you read the fine print: "US only." Work In Slippers is different. We read every listing before it goes live and label exactly who can apply: 🌍 anywhere in the world, 📍 specific countries, or 🗺️ regions like EMEA and APAC. You know if a job is open to you before you click. No account needed to apply, and companies post for free.

posts.name: Takers
posts.tagline: Any takers? Fill your golf, padel or 5-a-side game
posts.description: Got a tee time or a court and need players? Post it on Takers and your friends grab the open spots. No more chasing in the group chat. Not sure when people are free? Send a date poll and lock the winner into a game with one tap. Works for golf, padel, tennis, five-a-side or anything you play with friends. Free on iPhone and the web.
